title: LORD, LET MY DAY END IN VICTORY AND PRAISE | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: But I come before your throne of grace in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, standing on the authority of your word that declares this is the day that you have made and I will rejoice and be glad in it. I thank you for the gift of this new day, for the breath in my lungs, for the strength in my body, for the clarity in my mind, and for the peace in my heart. Lord, as I step into this day, I make a decree and declare that this day will not end in defeat, but in victory.

This day will not conclude in sorrow, but in praise. This day will not finish in failure, but in triumph. This day will not terminate in mourning, but in celebration. I prophesy to this day and command it to align with the purposes of God. I speak to the hours and decree that they work together for my good. I address the minutes and declare that they cooperate with heaven's agenda. I call to the seconds and proclaim that they serve divine purposes.

From morning until evening, from sunrise to sunset, from dawn to dusk, let everything that happens today culminate in victory and praise. I decree and declare that I begin this day in faith and I will end it in testimony. I start this morning in hope and I will finish this evening in manifestation. I commence these hours in expectation and I will conclude them in celebration. I initiate this period in prayer and I will terminate it in praise. By the time the sun sets today, I will have reasons to glorify God.

By the time evening arrives, I will have causes to magnify the Lord. By the time darkness falls, I will have testimonies to declare. By the time this day ends, I will have victories to celebrate. I am not just hoping for a good day. I am decreeing a victorious day. I am not merely wishing for positive outcomes. I am declaring triumphant results. I am not simply desiring favorable circumstances. I am commanding successful conclusions.

This day belongs to the Lord and the Lord makes all things work together for my good because I love him and I am called according to his purpose. I declare that every challenge I face today will become a testimony by evening. Every obstacle I encounter this morning will become a stepping stone by nightfall. Every difficulty I meet this afternoon will become a victory story by sunset. Every problem I confront today will become a praise report by day's end. I will not be defeated by circumstances.

I will not be overwhelmed by situations. I will not be conquered by challenges. I will not be subdued by difficulties. I am more than a conqueror through Christ who loves me. I am an overcomer by the blood of the lamb and the word of my testimony. I am a victor because greater is he who is in me than he who is in the world. I am triumphant because the Lord always causes me to triumph in Christ Jesus.

Therefore, I approach this day with confidence, knowing that victory is already secured, triumph is already guaranteed, success is already assured, and praise is already prepared. Father, I decree and declare that every conversation I have today will end in victory and praise. Every meeting I attend will conclude with positive outcomes. Every interaction I experience will result in favorable conclusions. Every exchange I participate in will produce beneficial results.

I will not have any conversation today that leaves me discouraged. I will not engage in any discussion that brings me down. I will not participate in any dialogue that steals my joy. I will not involve myself in any talk that diminishes my faith. Every word I speak today will be seasoned with grace. Every sentence I utter will carry divine wisdom. Every statement I make will release kingdom power. Every declaration I voice will manifest heaven's will.

By evening time, I will look back at my conversations and praise God for how he guided my tongue, directed my words, controlled my speech, and ordered my communication. I declare that every decision I make today will prove to be wise by evening. Every choice I select will demonstrate divine guidance by nightfall. Every option I pick will reveal heavenly direction by sunset. Every path I take will show kingdom leading by day's end. I will not make any decision today that I will regret by evening.

I will not choose any option today that will bring me sorrow by nightfall. I will not select any path today that will lead to failure by sunset. I will not pick any alternative today that will result in defeat by day's end. The spirit of God guides me in all my decisions. The wisdom of God directs me in all my choices. The understanding of God illuminates me in all my selections. The knowledge of God instructs me in all my options.

Therefore, when this day ends, I will praise God for how he led me, guided me, directed me, and instructed me in making every decision that brought victory and not defeat, success and not failure, triumph and not loss. I decree and declare that every financial transaction I engage in today will end in victory and praise. Every business dealing I participate in will conclude with profit and not loss. Every monetary exchange I conduct will result in increase and not decrease.

Every economic activity I perform will produce multiplication and not subtraction. I will not lose money today. I will gain resources. I will not experience lack today. I will encounter abundance. I will not suffer shortage today. I will receive sufficiency. I will not face deficit today. I will obtain surplus. The Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want. The Lord is my provider. I shall not lack. The Lord is my supplier. I shall not beg. The Lord is my source. I shall not suffer.

By the time this day ends, I will count my blessings and discover that provision came when I needed it. Supply arrived when I required it. Resources appeared when I requested them. And abundance manifested when I expected it. My day will end in financial victory and economic praise. Father, I declare that every project I work on today will end in victory and praise. Every task I undertake will conclude with excellence. Every assignment I handle will result in outstanding performance.

Every responsibility I manage will produce exceptional outcomes. I will not struggle with any project today. I will not fail at any task. Today I will not mess up any assignment today. I will not bungle any responsibility. Today the grace of God rest upon my work. The anointing of God empowers my labor. The favor of God accompanies my efforts. The blessing of God crowns my endeavors. Whatever my hands find to do, I do it with all my might and it prospers. Whatever I touch turns to gold. Whatever I handle succeeds.

Whatever I manage flourishes. By evening time, I will review my day's work and praise God for how he enabled me to complete tasks with excellence, finish projects with success, accomplish assignments with distinction, and fulfill responsibilities with honor. I decree and declare that every journey I take today will end in victory and praise. Every trip I make will conclude with safe arrival. Every travel I undertake will result in secure destination. Every movement I engage in will produce protected passage.

I will not have any accident today. I will not experience any incident. Today I will not encounter any mishap today. I will not face any calamity today. The angels of the Lord encamp around me as I travel. The presence of God accompanies me as I move. The protection of heaven covers me as I journey. The shield of the Almighty guards me as I go. I shall go out with joy and be led forth with peace. I shall depart with blessing and arrive with thanksgiving. I shall live with prayer and return with praise.

By the time this day ends, I will have traveled safely to every destination, arrived securely at every location, moved protected through every passage, and journeyied covered by every route. My travels today will end in victory and praise. I declare that every relationship I engage with today will end in victory and praise. Every person I meet will leave me better than they found me. Every individual I interact with will add value to my life and not subtract.

Every human I encounter will bring blessing and not cursing. Every personality I contact will contribute positively and not negatively. I will not have any toxic interaction today. I will not experience any draining relationship today. I will not encounter any negative person today who succeeds in bringing me down. I will not face any individual today who manages to steal my joy. I am protected from every evil personality. I am shielded from every wicked character. I am guarded from every negative individual.

I am defended from every toxic person. Those who are for me will manifest clearly. Those who are against me will be exposed and kept at bay. Those who are meant to help me will find me. Those who are assigned to harm me will miss me. By evening time, I will look back at my interactions and praise God for the divine connections he brought my way, the strategic relationships he established, the kingdom associations he created and the destiny partnerships he formed.

Father, I decree and declare that every spiritual battle I face today will end in victory and praise. Every attack launched against me will be defeated. Every scheme plotted against me will be frustrated. Every trap set for me will catch its setter. Every weapon formed against me will backfire on its maker. I am not fighting in my own strength. I fight in the strength of the Lord. I am not waring with carnal weapons. I war with spiritual weapons that are mighty through God to the pulling down of strongholds.

I am not struggling against flesh and blood. I struggle against principalities and powers that I have authority over through Christ Jesus. The battle is not mine. It is the Lord's. The Lord fights for me while I hold my peace. The Lord goes before me as a mighty warrior. The Lord surrounds me as my shield and exceeding great reward. By the time this day ends, every spiritual battle will have been won. Every demonic attack will have been repelled. Every satanic scheme will have been exposed.

And every evil plot will have been destroyed. My day will end in spiritual victory and supernatural praise. I declare that every temptation I face today will end in victory and praise. Every seduction presented to me will be resisted. Every enticement offered to me will be rejected. Every allurement shown to me will be refused. Every bait set before me will be ignored. I will not fall into sin today. I will not yield to temptation today. I will not surrender to seduction today.

I will not succumb to enticement today. God is faithful and he will not allow me to be tempted beyond what I am able to bear. With every temptation, he provides a way of escape so that I can endure it. The spirit of God strengthens me against every temptation. The word of God fortifies me against every seduction. The grace of God empowers me against every enticement. The blood of Jesus protects me against every allurement.

By evening time, I will praise God for how he helped me overcome every temptation, resist every seduction, reject every enticement, and refuse every allurement. My day will end with my integrity intact, my purity preserved, my holiness maintained, and my righteousness sustained. I decree and declare that every health challenge I face today will end in victory and praise. Every pain in my body will be healed. Every weakness in my system will be strengthened. Every malfunction in my organs will be corrected.

Every abnormality in my cells will be normalized. I will not be sick today. I will not be weak today. I will not be afflicted today. I will not be diseased today. By the stripes of Jesus, I am healed. By his wounds, I am made whole. By his suffering, my health is restored. By his resurrection, my body is vitalized. Divine health flows through my veins. Supernatural strength energizes my muscles. Miraculous vitality empowers my systems. Heavenly wellness permeates my organs.

By the time this day ends, I will praise God for keeping me in health, maintaining me in strength, preserving me in vitality, and sustaining me in wellness. My day will end with my body functioning properly, my health operating optimally, my strength flowing abundantly, and my vitality manifesting supernaturally. Father, I declare that every emotional challenge I face today will end in victory and praise. Every attempt to make me angry will fail. Every scheme to make me anxious will be frustrated.

Every plot to make me depressed will be defeated. Every plan to make me discouraged will be destroyed. I will not be controlled by negative emotions today. I will not be dominated by toxic feelings today. I will not be ruled by destructive sentiments today. I will not be governed by harmful moods today. The peace of God guards my heart. The joy of the Lord is my strength. The love of Christ constrains me. The grace of God stabilizes me. I cast all my anxiety on him because he cares for me.

I cast down every imagination and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God. I bring every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ. I think on things that are true, honest, just, pure, lovely, and of good report. By evening time, I will look back and praise God for emotional stability, mental clarity, spiritual strength, and psychological wellness that characterize my entire day.

I decree and declare that every disappointment that could occur today is cancelled and replaced with divine appointment. Every setback that could happen today is prevented and substituted with comebacks. Every failure that could manifest today is stopped and exchanged with success. Every loss that could materialize today is blocked and swapped with gain. I am not walking into a day of defeat. I am walking into a day of victory. I am not entering a period of loss. I am entering a season of gain.

I am not stepping into hours of failure. I am STEPPING INTO HOURS OF SUCCESS. I am not proceeding into moments of setback. I am proceeding into moments of advancement. The Lord orders my steps. The Lord directs my path. THE LORD GUIDES MY JOURNEY. THE LORD navigates my course. HE LEADS ME IN PATHS of righteousness for his name's sake. He makes my way prosperous and gives me good success. He causes me to triumph always in Christ Jesus.

He makes all things work together for my good because I love him and I am called according to his purpose. I declare that every door I need to be opened today will open. Every opportunity I need to be presented today will appear. Every connection I need to be made today will form. Every resource I need to be provided today will materialize. I will NOT MISS ANY DIVINE opportunity today. I will not overlook any kingdom connection today. I will not bypass any heavenly provision today.

I will not ignore any spiritual resource today. My spiritual eyes are open to see what God is doing. My spiritual ears are attentive to hear what God is saying. My spiritual senses are alert TO PERCEIVE WHAT GOD IS REVEALING. MY SPIRITUAL FACULTIES ARE SHARP TO DISCERN WHAT GOD IS SHOWING. By the time this day ends, I will have walked through open doors, seized presented opportunities, form strategic connections, and receive provided resources.

MY DAY WILL END with me praising God for divine favor that opened doors, supernatural grace that presented opportunities, kingdom wisdom that formed connections and heavenly provision that supplied resources. I decree and declare that by the time this day ends, I will have multiple reasons to praise God. I will have numerous causes to glorify the Lord. I will have several occasions to magnify his name. I will have various grounds to exalt his majesty. I will praise him for protection that kept me safe.

I will glorify HIM FOR PROVISION THAT SUPPLIED my needs. I WILL MAGNIFY him for favor that opened doors. I will exalt him for grace that strengthened me. I will praise him FOR WISDOM THAT GUIDED my decisions. I WILL GLORIFY HIM FOR POWER THAT DEFEATED my enemies. I WILL MAGNIFY HIM for love that sustained my relationship. I will exalt him FOR MERCY THAT FORGAVE my shortcomings. I will praise him for faithfulness that never failed. I WILL GLORIFY him for goodness that never ceased.

I will magnify him for kindness that never ended. I will exalt HIM FOR COMPASSION THAT NEVER RAN OUT. I declare that this day will produce testimonies that I will share for years to come. This day will generate stories that I will tell for seasons ahead. This day will create experiences that I will recount for periods forward. This day will establish memories that I will remember for times future. Something significant will happen today that will mark my life.

Something substantial will occur today that will change my story. Something momentous will take place today that will alter my narrative. Something remarkable will transpire today that will transform my testimony. I am not just having another ordinary day. I am living an extraordinary day. I am not just experiencing another regular day. I am encountering an exceptional day. I am not just going through another normal day. I am navigating a supernatural day. I am not just passing another common day.

I am participating in an uncommon day. This is a day of divine visitation. This is a day of heavenly manifestation. This is a day of kingdom demonstration. This is a day of spiritual revelation. I decree and declare that every negative prediction spoken over this day is cancelled. Every evil prophecy pronounced over this day is nullified. Every wicked projection made about this day is voided. Every satanic expectation held for this day is frustrated.

The enemy said this day would end in defeat, but I decree it ends in victory. Darkness predicted this day would conclude in sorrow, but I declare it concludes in praise. Hell prophesied this day would finish in failure, but I proclaim it finishes in success. Satan projected this day would terminate in loss, but I announce it terminates in gain. I reverse every negative word spoken over this day. I cancel every evil declaration made about this day. I nullify every wicked pronouncement uttered concerning this day.

I frustrate every satanic expectation held regarding this day. This day will not bow to the predictions of the enemy. This day will not align with the expectations of darkness. This day will not conform to the prophecies of hell. This day will not submit to the projections of Satan. This day belongs to the Lord. And it will end according to his word, in his favor, by his grace, through his power, with his blessing.

Holy Spirit, father, I declare that as the sun sets this evening, my mouth will be filled with praise. As darkness falls tonight, my lips will overflow with thanksgiving. As day transitions tonight, my heart will bubble with gratitude. As evening arrives, my spirit will soar with worship. I will not end this day complaining. I will end it praising. I will not conclude this hours murmuring. I will conclude them worshiping. I will not finish this period grumbling. I will finish it thanking.

I will not terminate this day criticizing. I will terminate it glorifying. My last words today will be words of praise. My final thoughts today will be thoughts of gratitude. My closing actions today will be actions of thanksgiving. My ending posture today will be a posture of worship. I will bless the Lord at all times. His praise shall continually be in my mouth. I will give thanks to the Lord for he is good. His mercy endures forever. I will praise the LORD WITH MY WHOLE HEART.

I will show forth all his marvelous works. I will sing praise to his name. Oh most high, I decree and declare that when I lay my head on my pillow tonight, I will do so with a smile on my face and peace in my heart. When I close my eyes to sleep tonight, I will do so with thanksgiving on my lips and joy in my spirit. When I drift into rest tonight, I will do so with praise in my mouth and gratitude in my soul. When I enter sleep tonight, I will do so with worship in my heart and glory to God in my mind.

This day will not end with worry keeping me awake. This evening will not conclude with anxiety stealing my sleep. This night will not begin with fear robbing my rest. This period will not commence with stress disturbing my peace. I will lie down in peace and sleep. For the Lord alone makes me dwell in safety. I will not be afraid of the terror by night or the arrow that flies by day. I will not fear the pestilence that walks in darkness or the destruction that waste at noonday.

The Lord is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The Lord is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid? I declare that this day ends in victory and praise. Not defeat and despair, not failure and frustration, not loss and lamentation, not setback and sorrow, but victory and praise, triumph and thanksgiving, success and celebration, gain and gratitude, win and worship, breakthrough and blessing, conquest and commendation, achievement and adoration. I seal this declaration with the blood of Jesus.

I confirm this decree with the word of God. I establish this proclamation with the authority of the name of Jesus Christ. Let my day end in victory and praise. It is decreed. It is declared. It is done. It is established. It is manifested. It is accomplished. It is secured. It is guaranteed. From morning to evening, from sunrise to sunset, from dawn to dusk, from beginning to end, let everything that happens today culminate in victory and praise.
In the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I have prayed and decreed. And all of God's people say, "Amen.
